steps.problem: The code flow is right. index.html:832/838 has 'Export ready' and 'Save'. deliver() opens the share sheet when canShare allows, and downloads otherwise. A dismissed sheet (AbortError) keeps the card up with Save live again, and a download closes the card. The NEW parentheticals cannot be confirmed in code and are partly doubtful. (a) 'Android: Photos or Files': Android share targets depend on the apps installed. Google Photos' target uploads to the user's Photos account rather than simply saving a file, and many phones have no 'Files' target, so this can send Android users looking for options that aren't there. (b) 'If no sheet appears, the video was downloaded (iPhone: Files > Downloads)': on any iPhone from iOS 15 on, canShare is true, so this branch almost never runs there. A Safari download also shows its own download prompt, which reads as 'a sheet', and in an installed home-screen app iOS may not put it in Files > Downloads at all. (c) 'If you close it, tap Save again': 'it' could mean the Export ready card, which has no close button, only Discard. It should name the share sheet.
steps.correct_text: When Export ready shows, tap Save, then choose the option that saves the video to your phone (on iPhone it is called Save Video; on Android, pick your gallery or files app). If you close that share sheet without saving, tap Save again. If no share sheet opens at all, the browser downloaded the video instead.

summary: All the batch-2 corrections were applied, and the phone flow now works end to end at b46b47d3. In order: slide to 0, back arrow once (which deselects, mobile.js:345), 'Tap to add a layer' opens the sheet, then Audio > Import audio. The song lands at the playhead, selected, in a solo row, with its panel open at the grid. Then the Volume card (number box plus a reversed ruler, with the Fade in (s)/Fade out (s) rulers and type-in boxes under it). To cut: deselect, slide to the video's end, tap the song, and tap the right-hand 'Trim end to playhead'. A quick tap on the counter then plays from 0, because play rewinds when the playhead is at the end. Three things need fixing. Step 1 has two garbled sentences, about where the song starts and 'move at once'. Step 8 never says how to deselect, and adds an unnecessary 'go back to the cards': reselecting always reopens the grid (inspector.js:7071-7074). The computer paragraph leaves out that the PC back arrow goes to Home instead of deselecting, and that the D keycap only shows on the card grid, not inside Volume (timeline.js:5771). It also leaves out that a mouse drag on a clip moves the clip, and that the Audio tab can be icon-only. Several citations have drifted (2322, 473-474, 7167, 6745-6750, 5645), but every label quoted is exact.
